purpose: Pre-specify deterministic MRI window geometry and case-level valid-support aggregation before generating any D0-C3 DeltaZ scientific result.
design_completion_note: This is a new pre-inference spatial design completion because D0-B4b did not uniquely define case-level spatial sampling. It is not represented as previously specified by D0-B4b.

input_and_preprocessing.normalization: existing full-volume nonzero z-normalization, independently per modality; preserve original zero voxels
input_and_preprocessing.padding: zero-pad only on the high end of each spatial axis after full-volume normalization
input_and_preprocessing.padding_target_rule: For each axis choose the smallest integer >= max(original_axis_size, window_axis_size) that is divisible by encoder_stride=8.

window_geometry.window_starts_rule: Take 0, stride, 2*stride, ... while start+window_size <= padded_size; append padded_size-window_size if absent.
window_geometry.window_index_order: lexicographic product of d starts, then h starts, then w starts

manifest.latent_coordinates: Raw window starts/stops divided exactly by 8; all starts are divisible by 8.

tensor_geometry.local_to_global_mapping: global_index = window_start/8 + local_index; direct integer placement with no interpolation.

support.raw_support: any of the four modalities is nonzero at the voxel

case_level_overlap_aggregation.per_global_cell: Arithmetic mean of local DeltaZ contributions only from windows where the local support mask is valid.
case_level_overlap_aggregation.contribution_count: Count of valid window contributions for each global latent cell.
case_level_overlap_aggregation.zero_contribution: Mark invalid in valid_support_global; do not treat the stored zero placeholder as a zero-signal observation.

noise_identity.source_contract: D0-B4b randomness contract, applied to this manifest's window coordinates
noise_identity.sample_identity: [case_id, start_d, start_h, start_w, stop_d, stop_h, stop_w]
noise_identity.serialization: compact ordered JSON array, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=false, UTF-8, no trailing newline
noise_identity.noise: Separate CPU torch.Generator per case/window/replicate; draw FP32 torch.randn((256,12,12,12)); transfer to execution device.
